input.source: user-provided lawful dump, kept outside git

X0.note: User-provided external retail XEX hash and title identity verified; no game binary or assets are tracked

X1.note: SDK v0.10.0 is pinned; eighteen live-memory-derived function entries have focused static regressions. ReXGlue codegen and Linux AMD64 build now accept the 68-byte 0x82341198 dispatcher; its runtime execution and the broader PPC/import/lowering report remain open.

X2.note: The 68-byte 0x82341198 dispatcher passes ReXGlue codegen and the Linux AMD64 build, but the latest controlled run still did not reach it. A new queue probe shows the guest waiting in 0x823A0310 with cursors 1/21; the runtime log confirms VdSetGraphicsInterruptCallback, VdInitializeRingBuffer, and VdEnableRingBufferRPtrWriteBack were ignored because gpu_plugin was not set. Treat this as an unconfigured Xenos graphics path, not a proven PPC/P-code defect; repeat after Process 2's plugin integration. The user confirmed that the loading screen appeared in a ReXGlue Xbox run, but the exact process/build hash is unknown and the screen is no longer visible, so this is not correlated to the controlled runtime.

X3.note: The latest Linux AMD64 run used ReXGlue 0.10.0 without gpu_plugin. Its log shows the three XEX Vd graphics/ring calls were ignored. At the later guest queue wait, head/tail remained 1/21 for 45 seconds and the 0x02 predicate bit was clear. This is consistent with the missing Xenos plugin preventing ring progress; it is not proof of retail draw/present or of a PPC/P-code failure. Process 2 owns plugin setup and the next graphics validation.

X4.note: The user confirmed that the original game's loading screen appeared during a ReXGlue Xbox run. The exact process/build hash was not recorded and the screen is no longer visible. The main menu, retail frame, and offline race remain unverified.

X5.note: No SHIFT Xbox runtime execution on target architectures

X6.note: Source audit found a Vulkan 1.1 path but three optional feature bits are hard requirements; device feature probe and retail draw/present proof are pending
